summary: Pilot-only: adopt prior vote-trail's stab screen + RF/KNN soft vote, compare screen variants by honest nested CV, lock best, seal screen milestone
reasoning: Building on the prior vote trail's step-21, whose vote_lib.py defines the pilot-only stab_screen (bootstrap-stability F test, ≤50 features) and nested_vote_cv (honest nested CV re-fitting screen, grids and vote weight inside each outer fold). Its screen comparisons on pilot were 'as expected', so I expect a stab screen + soft vote to clear the screen-milestone floor on pilot. Plan: (1) copy vote_lib.py into this workspace, (2) calibrate runtime on one nested-CV run (prints only), (3) run a pilot-only comparison of screens {top20F, stab.5, stab.3, stab.2} over seeds 0-1 and pick the winner by pre-set rule (highest mean cv_auc, tie-break lower sd), then decide Manhattan vs Euclidean KNN on the winner (switch only if it beats Euclid by >0.005), (4) write the locked procedure's {cv_auc (mean over seeds 0-2), n_features (full-pilot screen)} to out/metrics.json. All of this reads pilot.csv only; heldout stays sealed. Success rule fixed in advance: cv_auc >= 0.7 and n_features <= 50 → lock; otherwise replace the plan and search differently (e.g., interaction features or different screen family).
